description: Implementation of NoteRepository handling note data operations, synchronization with backend, and database interactions in an Android app.

classes.name: NoteRepositoryImpl
classes.description: Implementation of NoteRepository managing note data, synchronization, and database operations.

methods.name: syncNotes
methods.description: Synchronizes local notes with remote backend, handling updates, deletions, and mappings.

methods.name: applyLocalUpdates
methods.description: Applies local note actions such as create, update, delete to the database and remote backend.

methods.name: applyRemoteUpdates
methods.description: Processes remote note actions and applies them via remote backend.

methods.name: applyMappingChanges
methods.description: Updates local mappings based on synchronization results.

methods.name: insertNote
methods.description: Inserts a new note into the database and optionally syncs with remote backend.

methods.name: updateNotes
methods.description: Updates multiple notes in the database and optionally syncs.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates a single note in the database and optionally syncs.

methods.name: moveNotesToBin
methods.description: Moves notes to bin (soft delete) and optionally syncs deletion.

methods.name: restoreNotes
methods.description: Restores notes from bin and re-syncs if applicable.

methods.name: deleteNotes
methods.description: Permanently deletes notes from database and optionally from remote backend.

methods.name: discardEmptyNotes
methods.description: Deletes notes with empty titles.

methods.name: permanentlyDeleteNotesInBin
methods.description: Permanently deletes all notes in the bin.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a note by ID as a Flow.

methods.name: getDeleted
methods.description: Retrieves deleted notes as a Flow.

methods.name: getArchived
methods.description: Retrieves archived notes as a Flow.

methods.name: getNonDeleted
methods.description: Retrieves non-deleted notes as a Flow.

methods.name: getNonDeletedOrArchived
methods.description: Retrieves notes that are not deleted or archived as a Flow.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all notes as a Flow.

methods.name: getByNotebook
methods.description: Retrieves notes by notebook ID.

methods.name: getNonRemoteNotes
methods.description: Retrieves notes not synchronized with a specific cloud provider.

methods.name: getNotesWithoutNotebook
methods.description: Retrieves notes without an assigned notebook.

methods.name: getNotesByCloudService
methods.description: Retrieves notes mapped to a specific cloud service.

methods.name: deleteIdMappingsForCloudService
methods.description: Deletes all ID mappings for a specific cloud service.
